thread:
oliver: Heads-up: VertexLabs flagged INV-9002 — they've been billed a cross-region burst charge plus a reserved-commit for the same capacity. Invoice shows Reserved commit (us-east) $12,000 and Burst overage (eu-west) $12,000. They say commit was region-agnostic.

clare: send the invoice snippet?

mina: invoice export: {"customer":"VERT","period":"2027-02","line_items":[{"type":"reserved_commit","region":"us-east","amount":12000},{"type":"burst","region":"eu-west","amount":12000}]}

billing-bot: Usage ingest: /artifacts/usage/INV-9002-2027-02.csv (ok). Meter shows committed tokens tagged to region on allocation time.

vendor-meter: Note: vendor sync for region affinity erroneously split commit attribution during cross-region failover on 2487651000. Two tag keys created: commit:VERT:2027-02:default and commit:VERT:2027-02:eu-mirror.

oliver: customer claims their SLA and contract are region-agnostic and they purchased a single reserved commit. Can we reclassify burst as covered by reserved capacity?

mina: Technically we can reattribute usage if tags map to same purchase. Reconciliation needed to merge commit tags and recalc burst.

clare: Finance: approve provisional credit up to $12,000 for the burst amount while we reconcile?

billing-bot: Created provisional credit CR-9002-PROV $12,000 PENDING.

mina: Starting merge job at 2487654400. ETA 10m.

billing-bot: Reconciliation finished. Merged commit tags. New invoice /exports/invoices/INV-9002-2027-02-v2.json shows single reserved_commit $12,000 and burst removed. Original invoice superseded.

clare: Voiding provisional credit CR-9002-PROV. GL memo: 'Reclassification of cross-region burst to reserved commit after vendor tag fix.'

oliver: Notified VertexLabs and offered postmortem. They accepted reissued invoice. Thanks team.
